nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a, b]$, let $\eta \in \mathbb{R}$, and let $\omega_f(\eta)$ be the modulus of continuity of $f$ on $[a, b]$ at scale $\eta$. For all $x, y \in [a, b]$ with $|x - y| \le \eta$, we have $|f(x) - f(y)| \le \omega_f(\eta)$.
nodes.title: The modulus of continuity bounds increments

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a, b]$. Then for every $\eta \in \mathbb{R}$ the set $\{|f(x) - f(y)| : x, y \in [a, b],\ |x - y| \le \eta\}$ is bounded above.
nodes.title: The set defining the modulus of continuity is bounded above

nodes.summary: Let $a \le b$, let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a, b]$, and write $\omega_f(\eta)$ for the modulus of continuity of $f$ on $[a, b]$ at scale $\eta$. If $0 \le \eta_1 \le \eta_2$, then $\omega_f(\eta_1) \le \omega_f(\eta_2)$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the modulus of continuity

nodes.summary: Let $a \le b$ and let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a, b]$. For every $\eta \ge 0$, the modulus of continuity $\omega_f(\eta)$ of $f$ on $[a, b]$ at scale $\eta$ satisfies $0 \le \omega_f(\eta)$.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the modulus of continuity

nodes.summary: Let $a \le b$ and let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a, b]$. Then the modulus of continuity $\omega_f(\eta)$ of $f$ on $[a, b]$ tends to $0$ as $\eta \to 0^+$.
nodes.title: Theorem I (Modulus of continuity vanishes)

nodes.summary: For a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, real numbers $a$ and $b$, and a scale $\eta \in \mathbb{R}$, the modulus of continuity of $f$ on $[a, b]$ at scale $\eta$ is
nodes.title: Modulus of continuity

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
